verdict.rationale: BILL clearly ships a versioned API: the v3 API uses /v3/ paths, there is a 'why upgrade to v3' guide implying earlier versions, and a dated changelog exists. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-support guarantees, so only the versioning half of the story is delivered. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, version support windows or migration timelines, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Use the BILL v3 API & access the full breadth of the BILL API Platform: AP, AR, & S&E.
creating a vendor is a simple `POST` to `/v3/vendors`, and modifying a vendor is a `PATCH` to `/v3/vendors/{vendorId}`
The BILL v3 API follows the REST architecture.
